# Requirements

Turn Codify's graph, spec, memory, MCP, ACP, and governance primitives into a vendor-neutral control plane that keeps coding agents truthful, live, grounded, progressing, and easy to integrate.

## Requirement 1: Truthful task and agent state

**User Story:** As a developer, I want Codify to distinguish declarations from live work so that stale task metadata can never impersonate an active agent.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN an agent asks for current work in parallel mode THE spec engine SHALL return only a task backed by that agent's live owned attempt and SHALL report stale in_progress declarations separately.
2. WHEN a task attempt starts THE runtime SHALL assign an attempt id and monotonically fenced ownership token, persist heartbeats, and refuse stale owners after expiry or reassignment.
3. WHEN repository state is inspected THE output SHALL label Git state, Codify snapshot state, spec declaration state, and live runtime ownership independently.
4. WHEN declarations and live ownership disagree THE reconcile command SHALL diagnose the contradiction without mutation by default and SHALL repair only with an explicit flag.

## Requirement 2: Portable agent integration

**User Story:** As a developer, I want one safe Codify integration workflow across coding agents so that each host receives the right MCP, instructions, skills, and lifecycle hooks without hand-edited configuration.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN integration is inspected THE adapter registry SHALL report host capabilities and configuration state for Codex, Claude Code, Copilot and VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Zed, Windsurf, Cline, and Continue.
2. WHEN integration is planned THE command SHALL show every intended path and action without writing, and apply SHALL be idempotent, preserve existing configuration, and create recoverable backups before modifying existing files.
3. WHEN portable assets are installed THE repository SHALL receive a concise Agent Skill plus compatible hook shims that route native lifecycle JSON into one Codify event command.
4. WHEN doctor runs THE command SHALL detect missing binaries, malformed or incomplete integration, stale server names, unsupported protocol versions, and conflicting generated-file ownership.

## Requirement 3: Progress without drift or useless loops

**User Story:** As a developer, I want Codify to measure novel work and intervene when an agent drifts or loops so that autonomous sessions remain productive and recoverable.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN a lifecycle event arrives THE runtime SHALL normalize it into a session and attempt event with a stable fingerprint, workspace revision, and explainable evidence delta.
2. WHEN repeated events produce no new artifact, evidence, resolved failure, or criteria coverage THE progress engine SHALL classify the pattern and return a bounded recovery action rather than blindly continuing.
3. WHEN a long command is active THE runtime SHALL treat heartbeats and changing output as activity without falsely claiming implementation progress.
4. WHEN progress stalls THE escalation SHALL move through warn, re-plan, bounded experiment, handoff or waiting_input, and optional stop while remaining advisory unless policy explicitly enables enforcement.

## Requirement 4: Fast revisioned work packets

**User Story:** As a coding agent, I want one compact task-aware context call and delta updates so that I spend tokens implementing instead of repeatedly rediscovering repository state.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN work opens THE packet SHALL include objective, criteria, allowed scope, independently labeled state, relevant memories, focused code context, tests, and the last failure or progress event.
2. WHEN the caller supplies a prior revision THE update SHALL return only state, evidence, and workspace changes since that revision.
3. WHEN work closes THE packet SHALL pair every acceptance criterion with recorded evidence or an explicit unverified result.

## Requirement 5: Modern interoperable protocols

**User Story:** As an integration author, I want Codify to negotiate current protocols honestly and expose the control plane through stable structured surfaces.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN MCP initializes THE server SHALL negotiate the current supported stable revision, advertise only capabilities it implements, and keep the first 512 instruction characters self-contained.
2. WHEN an MCP client lists tools THE control-plane state, reconcile, event, progress, and work-packet operations SHALL have stable schemas and accurate read/write annotations.
3. WHEN agent assets are rendered THEIR ownership SHALL be deterministic so spec render and agent context generation cannot overwrite one another.
4. WHEN the feature qualifies THE integration suite SHALL simulate stale tasks, lease expiry and fencing, heartbeat renewal, repeated no-progress events, install planning and repair, MCP negotiation, and work-packet deltas.
